question.text:
Match List - I with List - II.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text:
(A) Magnetic induction $\rightarrow$ Gauss (III)
(B) Magnetic intensity
$\left(\mathrm{H}=\frac{\mathrm{B}}{\mu}\right) \rightarrow$ Ampere $/$ meter (IV)
(C) Magnetic flux $\rightarrow$ Weber (Wb) (II)
(D) Magnetic moment $\rightarrow$ Ampere-meter ${ }^2$
$(\overrightarrow{\mathrm{M}}=\mathrm{i} \overrightarrow{\mathrm{~A}})$
